subcategory_text: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 4.2(b), Clause 5.2, Annex A.5.3, Annex A.5.10, Annex A.5.13, Annex A.5.14, Annex A.5.15, Annex A.6.1 (+8 more)
implementation_examples: Remove data that must remain confidential (e.g., from processors and memory) as soon as it is no longer needed
Protect data in use from access by other users and processes of the same platform
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that remove data that must remain confidential (e.g., from processors and memory) as soon as it is no longer needed.
Determine whether activities are conducted to protect data in use from access by other users and processes of the same platform.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
